scenes.headline: How Needle 3 scores its own tool calls
scenes.sub: The confidence head, and why a local fine-tune drops it.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Radar! Needle 3 is a tiny tool-calling model that scores its own calls. Here's how, and why a local fine-tune loses that score.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: A small post-hoc head reads the whole network, prompt and finished call together, and judges the call after it is made.
scenes.say: A small post-hoc head reads the whole network, prompt and finished call together, and judges the call after it is made.

steps.say: The head reads the prompt and the finished call at all twenty-one depths: the embedding, plus each of the twenty blocks.
Eighty-four probe vectors, one per depth and lane, each pool the whole trace into one summary.
Four query vectors attend across those summaries, and their results project down to a single logit.
Confidence is the minimum of that score and the decoder's own probability. A call is accepted only when both agree.

scenes.title: Why a local fine-tune drops it

items.say: The head reads the backbone under stop gradient. Training it cannot move one weight of the model it judges.
It was trained in a separate run and merged in at step ten thousand. No gradient path reaches it.
A local LoRA moves accuracy eighteen to thirty-six points, so the old head would predict failures that no longer happen.
So the build deletes the head, and confidence comes back as None.

scenes.title: A 20-layer archive, by export path
scenes.note: computed from the shipped file's own tensor records
scenes.say: The local path also exports at four bits, because its packer refuses anything else. A tuned archive is sixty-three point four four megabytes, against thirty-five point three four shipped.

scenes.text: Calibration is a fit, and a fit needs samples: the head has to be retrained with the model, on your tools.
scenes.say: Calibration is a fit, and a fit needs samples. The head has to be retrained with the model, on your own tools.

recap: A detached probe judges each finished call
A local LoRA can't train it, so build drops it
Local archives export at 4 bits, not 2
scenes.say: To recap: a detached probe judges each call, a local fine-tune drops it, and exports at four bits.
